derivation: plural active participle of H1058 (בָּכָה); (with the article) the weepers;

occurrences.text: And an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the Lord.
